notes.title: Playtest is NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
We are excited to share, that we just launched our [b]very first playtest[/b]! Make sure to [b]sign up on our Store page[/b], to grant access as early as possible.
Over the next few weeks we [b]will grant access to more and more playtesters[/b].

The best way to provide feedback is to[b] join our Discord[/b]:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/cy25R6CyCG]https://discord.com/invite/cy25R6CyCG[/url]

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugs and localisation issues are to be expected!
[*] For this very first playtest we only support English and German localisation in the Game. 
[*] More locales will follow! 
[/list]
[b]For Steam Deck/Controller users:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Deck and Controller support is in! If you encounter any issues with the Controls, please let us know via Discord.
[*] To Use/Buy/Sell Items use R1/RB
[*] If you find yourself stuck with D-Pad, use the Left Stick
[*] Reordering Letters/Stickers can be achieved by holding X/A and using the Left Stick
[*] PlayStation controllers should be working on Windows! If you encounter issues here, also let us know via Discord
[/list]

notes.title: Discord Launch & Closed Beta
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just launched our Discord Server and would like to invite you, if you want to keep up to date about development.

Additionally, we will do a Closed Beta Playtest early/mid March. We will send out Steam Beta Keys to interested players, so make sure to join the Discord if you'd like to be part of the Playtest :)

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cy25R6CyCG

notes.title: Visual Overhaul and Design Adjustments
notes.content:
We have been working a lot on the game recently and one of the big topics was the visual overhaul. So far we only had placeholder assets, to make a playable prototype.
This has changed now, and we are proud to present our new visual style for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186417/57235f63104558f22babea6f48cdb77ca61ab4bb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186417/846dbd5f2dcfa85a1b9ce3ec9f393c1385b87d13.png[/img]
Let us know what you think of the new Style!

Additonally, we renamed our Enhancement System to "Stickers", as they fit nicely into the new Style. You'll be able to collect a big variety of stickers, with several different variations, such as Foil, Holo, Golden, Reverse, and more. The Stickers will be the deciding factors for your run!

We are looking for some suggestions for Stickers to integrate into the game, that fit into the Game Design. As an example, which visible in the Screenshots: An Octopus sticker that grants +8 Mult.

Feel free to add your ideas below! We would love to add iconic items from other Games as Stickers, so if you have something in mind, let us know!

One last thing: We will soon be launching our Discord server! Keep your eyes open for that.
